scenarios.description: The reusable RF M by traffic N core across every checked-in home world.
expected_behavior: preserve every RF and traffic axis
never feed world truth into policy

scenarios.description: Ten clients cross several candidate cells slowly.
expected_behavior: bounded moves after hold and margin
no ping-pong

scenarios.description: Clients repeatedly cross wall and cell borders near policy thresholds.
expected_behavior: hysteresis suppresses repeated steering
short wall jumps do not cause oscillation

scenarios.description: The candidate opportunity may be shorter than roam cost.
expected_behavior: abstain when expected benefit horizon is too short

scenarios.description: Station-originated signal is weaker than AP-originated signal.
expected_behavior: do not silently treat uplink and downlink as the same fact

scenarios.description: Ten clients and their traffic appear together.
expected_behavior: serialize moves
avoid moving the cohort onto one target

scenarios.description: Clients disappear and later reappear without an optimizer action.
expected_behavior: expire stale policy state
treat reappearance as fresh association

scenarios.description: One extender is RF-isolated and then restored.
expected_behavior: clients recover
expired extender returns with the same identity

scenarios.description: Compare same-mesh 2.4 and 5 GHz candidates before a BTM action.
expected_behavior: choose a BSSID, not merely a band
retain 2.4 GHz when 5 GHz benefit is insufficient

scenarios.description: Compare same-mesh 5 and 6 GHz candidates under shorter 6 GHz reach.
expected_behavior: prefer 6 GHz only while measured benefit and persistence justify it

scenarios.description: Suppress selected 2.4 GHz probe responses to influence initial association.
expected_behavior: bounded suppression
failsafe association remains possible

scenarios.description: A controllable client ignores a valid BTM request without disconnecting.
expected_behavior: record no-change as an outcome
apply failure backoff without blind retry

scenarios.description: Select weighted graph edges and bands using backhaul quality and congestion.
expected_behavior: prefer 5 or 6 GHz when viable
use 2.4 GHz only as an explicit failsafe
avoid loops and partitions
measure interference and throughput
do not infer wide-channel gain from an hwsim 20 MHz clamp
